question: A ______ is an ordered list in which all insertions and deletions are made at one end.
solution:
The correct answer is __**stack**__.

__
 
• **A stack is an ordered list in which all insertions and deletions are made at one end.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A stack is an ordered list in which all insertions and deletions are made at one end that is called the top.
 
• A **queue **is an ordered list in which **all insertions take place at one end** that is at the rear, while **all deletions take place at the other end, the front.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9df88412553852a63f04819532ff35b54d191f11493f38648930d02b88cc24f7.png]
